messages:
incbot: ALERT: paging integration 'notify-proxy' heartbeat missing for 2m, automatic paging suppressed. affected_tenants: 3. runbook: https://redwood/runbooks/paging-fanout
emma: saw a Support ticket — customer reports they didn't get paged for a sev. are pages being queued or dropped?
satish: checking logs now, seeing repeated 502s from upstream webhook fanout: `POST /webhook -> 502`
chris: @satish can you paste the proxy logs? I can try re-routing to sms-gw if we need immediate mitigation
satish: snippets: `envoy: upstream response 502` and `error: signature verification failed: header truncated`
ops-bot: deploy event: canary envoy header-rewrite (team/ingress) at 2026-03-18T10:41Z
maria: that header rewrite included a `x-signature` trim to 200 chars — paging vendor expects full signature for verification
emma: so the integration fails signature check and incbot suppresses to avoid noisy retries? :thinking:
chris: yep. incbot logic suppresses when fanout returns auth/verification errors to avoid flapping pages to oncall
oncall-sre: oncall responding — this is impacting customer critical alerts (3 tenants). manual paging enabled?
satish: temporarily re-enabled fallback path: `fanout -> sms-gateway` for affected tenants. running curl to trigger test page now:
```
> curl -X POST https://redwood/trigger-test -d '{"tenant":"acct-42","message":"test page"}' -v
> HTTP/1.1 202 Accepted
> X-Delivery: fallback-sms
```
chris: test page went through via fallback. good.
emma: ops, should we roll back the header-rewrite in canary and patch signature trimming?
satish: rolling back canary now (evicting envoy change). will keep fallback enabled until we validate a fix. ETA 20m
maria: patch idea: preserve full `x-signature` and perform truncation downstream only if vendor requires. also add unit test for proxy header passthrough
incbot: NOTE: suppressed pages will not be auto-un-suppressed until handshake succeeds. manual escalations allowed via `/ops page-now`
emma: filing incident ticket and assigning owner. incident owner: @satish. customer comms: assigned to @chris for immediate triage and to @maria for root cause fix
oncall-sre: documenting mitigation in channel logs. will follow up with postmortem if impact >1h
satish: rollback completed on canary. I see successful fanout attempts now: `POST /webhook -> 200`
chris: re-enabled normal fanout for acct-42 and acct-99. monitoring for 10m then disable fallback
maria: creating PR with header-preserve change and test. tagging for review: platform-security and ingress.
emma: thanks all. quick summary in the ticket please — cause: envoy header-rewrite trimmed `x-signature` breaking vendor verification; mitigation: rollback canary + temporary sms fallback; next: PR and tests, postmortem owner: satish
incbot: RESOLVE: heartbeat restored at 2026-03-18T10:56Z. suppressed paging cleared manually by ops.
chris: closing thread for live mitigation. will keep ticket open for RCA and follow-up actions
maria: PR opened: https://git.redwood/pr/4521 (w/ tests)
emma: noted. :white_check_mark:
